notes: Open-end fund reorganization (N-14 information statement/prospectus, filed 2021-02-05, dated 'March __, 2021'). No shareholder vote is required, so meeting_date and record_date are null (a March 15, 2021 ownership date is not a voting record date). The excerpt ends in Appendix A before the agreement's termination clause, so termination_date is null. Separate parallel reorganization of MainStay MacKay U.S. Equity Opportunities Fund into the same acquirer is mentioned but is a different transaction, so n_targets is 1. Shares are open-end fund share classes, not common stock proper; security_class entered as 'other'. Tickers not printed in the excerpt. 'other' in conditions is the required dividend declaration by the target; the filing also lists accuracy of representations and covenant performance.
